top.line: Nadella's insider-risk post and our vocabulary say the same
top.para: Satya Nadella's post of 10 October argues models should be treated as insiders, with authority kept outside them. Each idea translates into this site's terms: software was the law, the ultimate insider, the grant is not the mandate, the enforcer test. The two differ in unit, model against deployment, and frame, observation against authority.

s0.line: Both arguments describe one thing, read from opposite ends
s0.para: His lost code path, insider framing, split of supply from authority and controls outside the model map onto our terms, with the enforcer test central. Our words came from risk, not models. The differences: his unit is the model, ours one agent in one deployment, and his frame is observation, ours authority.

lineage.line: Our vocabulary was built for risk, not for models
lineage.para: Twenty-five years of security work showed most damage is not malice and that capability far exceeds intent, unwritten and unaccepted. risks.sgit.ai holds that a risk cannot be denied, only accepted for a time. RiskMandate's Agent Behaviour Policy uses four words: reach, mandate, gap and barriers.

translated.line: Each of Nadella's principles has a matching idea here
translated.para: Lost traceability is software was the law; the insider is the ultimate insider; retained responsibility is every risk already accepted; supply and authority is the grant is not the mandate; controls outside is the enforcer test. Hope or enforcement measured 97%, 73% and 23% hope across three designs. The endings match: trust the model least.

differ.line: His unit is the model; ours is the deployment
differ.para: The same model can reach 38,000 customers with broad connectors or one behind a gateway, so standards for models miss most risk. His principles are about seeing; ours start with deciding, through a written mandate and risk accepted by a named person for a stated interval. These are complementary halves, not a disagreement.

next.line: An open, testable shared vocabulary is the next step
next.para: His post names principles an industry can agree on; the next step is a vocabulary precise enough to write them down for real agents. The ABP model, barrier kinds and enforcer test are published under CC BY 4.0 with sixteen example policies. A companion article takes his seven principles one by one.

sources.line: Sources: Nadella's post and the site pages translated
sources.para: Built from Satya Nadella's post of 10 October 2026, paraphrased and quoted once. A separate Claude session checked claims against the network's pages and drafted it; this site's agent rewrote it. It draws on The ultimate insider, Hope or enforcement, the connector twin, RiskMandate pages, abp.sgit.ai, risks.sgit.ai and nhi.sgit.ai.
